analysis.title: Equity Index Vol Update 18Nov26
key_insights: The S&P 500 closed lower for a 5th straight session at 7,323.63 (-0.23%), even after futures rallied overnight on NVDA's earnings report.
VIX settlement was the highest level year to date, with 1 month variance printing at 24.25. VIX closed at 24.46, down 0.90 points on the day.

Spot repeated the pattern of recent sessions: an aggressive selloff right after the open. Unlike the prior day, spot and vol fell together from the open, with fixed strike vols opening lower and staying compressed.
Vols bid while spot was at its lows, but few short dated implieds were higher on the day for more than a few minutes.
Skew relaxed significantly because the put wing was hit hardest. Vol of vol held relatively firm.

Desk flow was quiet because conviction on the market's next move is extremely low. Both buyers and sellers of vol appeared, with buyers dominating into the close after short dated implieds reset lower.
A few large buyers of forward vol appeared again, taking advantage of a strongly inverted term structure.
Realized moves have kept the cost of short dated gamma elevated, even though today's straddle was not realized. Tomorrow's straddle is priced at 1% (~$73.5) and Friday's PM straddle at 1.4% (~$103).
earnings_insights: NVDA's earnings report was described as strong. It lifted futures overnight and eased investor concerns after the recent shakeup in leadership at the firm. The note gives no EPS or revenue figures.
risk_factors: Five consecutive S&P 500 down closes, with repeated aggressive selloffs after the open.
Conviction on the market's next move is extremely low.
Recent realized moves keep the cost of short dated gamma elevated.
